description: Clicks from Google search, from Search Console. With no site, every site read from Search Console with its clicks and impressions against as many days before, and the searches nothing on two or more of the sites answers, grouped by subject. With a site: clicks by day, the totals against as many days before, and each page's clicks now against before, those that lost most first. A baseline to judge a change by. Only sites whose owner added mttr in Search Console have any.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next part of a long list.

show.description: lost (the default), gained, or all pages by clicks.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.

name: mttr_traffic
title: Get search traffic
